lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Circular high-luminance blobs are arranged in a series of near-vertical columns posterior to the gill region, showing a regular grid-like spatial distribution across the mid-section.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity align with the column-based blobs, forming a discernible grid where the spots act as high-intensity anchor nodes within the banding.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Prominent horizontal linear features extend across the upper flank, marked by a sharp luminance transition with higher intensity values on the dorsal aspect of the ridge and shadowed values on the ventral aspect.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin displays a discrete cluster of approximately 8 circular high-luminance blobs distributed across the anterior and central regions of the fin's macro-mask.

other_distinctive_markers: The terminal lobes of the caudal fin exhibit concentrated high-luminance patterning, specifically a bright patch on the lower lobe tip.
